about: Headline figures for the US data center water brief. Every entry traces to data/sources.md by source key. Values are as printed in the source unless a conversion is stated; conversions use 1 US gallon = 3.78541 liters.

amazon_withdrawal_2025_billion_gallons.note: Global data center footprint, withdrawal as Amazon words it; first absolute figure Amazon has published, June 2026, third-party assured per Amazon.

google_total_consumption_million_gallons.note: All operations, global. 2020-2024 as restated in the 2025 report appendix; 2025 from the 2026 report appendix.

meta_embedded_water_in_purchased_electri.note: Companywide purchased electricity; this is the only hyperscaler-published indirect water series found.

microsoft_total_consumed_million_cubic_m.note: All operations, global. FY24 uses an updated WUE-based estimation method for sites without metered actuals; Microsoft states prior years were not restated.

microsoft_zero_water_cooling_saving_m3_p.note: New datacenter design using chip-level cooling with no water evaporation for cooling; saving estimated at FY24 fleet withdrawal WUE.

eu_eed_threshold_kw_it.note: Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1364 under the recast Energy Efficiency Directive; annual reporting of energy, PUE, WUE, water input, renewable share, waste heat reuse; first reporting cycle 2024.

eu_first_cycle_coverage_pct.note: Share of estimated in-scope facilities that reported in the first cycle, per the European Commission assessment as reported in trade and policy press.

us_federal_mandate.note: No US federal requirement for data centers to report energy or water use was found as of October 2026; US figures in this brief come from voluntary company reporting and modeled federal estimates.

electricity_2028_projection_twh.note: Superseded as the lab's current outlook by the June 2026 update (S14); retained as the December 2024 report's published range.

lbnl_energy_2025_update.about: Electricity figures from LBNL's June 2026 update (S14). The update contains no water-use estimates; LBNL water figures in this package remain those of the December 2024 report (S1).

electricity_2024_twh.note: Falls at the low end of the range the December 2024 report (S1) projected for 2024.

electricity_2028_reference_case_twh.note: Falls in the middle of the December 2024 report's 325 to 580 TWh range (S1), which this update supersedes as the lab's current outlook.

consolidated_deployment.note: GPU and ASIC shipments lowered 15% vs. Reference Case.

high_asic.note: ASIC shipments raised 15% vs. Reference Case.

high_inference_energy.note: Higher AI server idle power and utilization for inference workloads.

low_accelerator_lifetime.note: Average AI accelerator operating lifetime reduced by one year (5 to 4).

growth_rates_as_printed.note: Stated in the update's conclusion. The 14% is against the update's own revised 2023 estimate; the update does not print a revised 2023 TWh total in its text, and 192 / 1.14 implies a revised 2023 value of about 168 TWh (derived).

historical_revision.note: The update's estimates for prior years fall slightly below the December 2024 report's, mainly due to a reduction in reported GPU shipments for 2023 and 2024 and revised AI inference power assumptions.

interconnection_capacity_2030_gw_referen.note: At an assumed 50% average utilization of interconnection capacity; average increase of 17.4 GW per year from 2024 to 2030.

share_of_us_load_growth_2024_2030_pct.note: Reference Case, against the forecast in NERC's 2025 Long-Term Reliability Assessment.

water_estimates_in_update.note: None. The update publishes no water withdrawal, consumption, or WUE figures; the word water appears only in passing. LBNL water figures remain S1 (December 2024).

direct_consumption_2028_hyperscale_only_.note: Hyperscale segment only; the report does not publish a 2028 all-segment direct water total in this passage.

altman_average_chatgpt_query_june2025.note: As cited in the Google paper from Altman's June 2025 blog post; no methodology published.

epoch_ai_gpt4o_energy_wh_per_query.note: Independent bottom-up estimate, energy only; Epoch AI did not publish a per-query water figure.

google_median_gemini_prompt_may2025.note: Water is onsite consumption only, computed from energy via consumptive WUE Category 2; excludes water consumed generating electricity.

ren_et_al_2023.note: Scope 1 plus scope 2 water; GPT-3-era inference; varies by location and time of day.

viral_claim_as_repeated.note: No published source states 500 mL per prompt. The sourced statement is 500 mL per roughly 10 to 50 requests (S8).

imm_scenario_87_forecast_load_only_incre.note: Forecast new data center load plus forecast growth of existing load, 4,654 MW; about 83% of the total data center increment.

imm_scenario_88_no_data_center_load_reve.note: Removes existing plus forecast data center load, 7,927 MW.

google_consumption_2021_million_gallons.note: The Dalles, Oregon campus; disclosed December 2022 after the city dropped a trade-secret lawsuit against The Oregonian; Google confirmed the figure and later restated it as almost 275 million gallons in its own 2023 site water profile.

derived_data_center_direct_share_of_tota.note: Derived: LBNL 2023 direct consumption (66 billion liters = 17.4 billion gallons per year) divided by USGS 2015 total withdrawals (322 Bgal/d x 365). Consumption compared against withdrawals; labeled as such wherever used.

derived_data_center_total_consumption_bi.note: Derived: LBNL direct 66 + indirect nearly 800 billion liters.
